Asana task descriptions in `/desk-asana` now keep their formatting, as on the web.

- The task detail reads the description's rich text (`html_notes`) and draws headings, bold, italic, strikethrough, bullet and numbered lists (nested too), inline code, code blocks, quotes, rules, tables, links and task mentions, with the same Markdown look as the preview pane
- Plain text that looks like Markdown (`*`, `_`, a line starting with `-` or `1.`) stays as written
- Underline has no Markdown form and shows as plain text; the terminal can't enlarge headings, so they are bold with a rule under them
- If the Asana server returns no rich text, the plain description is shown as before

## Install

```
/plugin install desk-look --marketplace KyongSik-Yoon/cc-desktop-mod
```

Already installed: `/desk-update` (or `claude plugin update desk-look`), then `/reload-plugins`.
